description: Recensement d’autres données ouvertes d’intérêt pour les hackathons IDFM is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Liste de jeux de données et API conseillées dans le cadre des hackathon set challenges DATA d'IDFM. La liste n'est évidemment pas limitative et vous pouvez suggérer l'ajout d'autres source de données via le Slack communauté PRIM. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Données administratives. The portal shows 2024-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
